nom: Avène Cleanance Hydra Ultra-Soothing Restorative Cream

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination skin generally report a light, non-oily finish, though two reviews with acne-prone skin found it too oily and heavy for their skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as very hydrating and effective for flaky, dehydrated patches, though a few report the cream itself left their skin dry or feeling under-moisturized.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers say it absorbs quickly, hydrates without an oily feel, and works well used as needed.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it is soothing and calms irritation (including rosacea and post-mask irritation), while multiple others report the fragrance burned, stung, or reddened their skin.
segments.mature: Mature-skin ('senior') reviewers describe it as gentle, water-based, and soothing on aging skin.

concerns.aging: Mature-skin reviewers report the cream feels gentle and soothing on aging skin, with no negative comments specific to aging noted.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describing dehydrated or dry skin report significant hydration relief, often after treatments like retinoids, adapalene, or accutane dried their skin out; a couple describe the formula as too light/lotion-like to lock in moisture for very dry skin.
concerns.redness: Reviewers using it for redness and irritation (from rosacea, masks, or actives) mostly report calming and soothing effects, but some describe the fragrance itself causing burning and redness on contact.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers using harsh actives (benzoyl peroxide, retinoids, adapalene) report the cream soothes irritation and resolves peeling and dry patches without triggering new breakouts.
concerns.spots: Reviewers dealing with acne-related dryness report no new breakouts and reduced irritation from spot treatments; one reviewer specifically notes it worked well on a tiny pimple.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report no clogged pores and no new breakouts even used alongside acne treatments, but two describe it as too oily for acne-prone skin, worsening oiliness.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers, including combination-skin users, report a non-oily, non-greasy finish, though a couple with acne-prone skin found it made their skin very oily.

aspects.libelle: Soothing on irritated or compromised skin
Consistency more like a lotion than a cream
